name: PubMed Article Search and Analysis Server

tasks.task: For Redwood Bioinformatics Lab (api key hash sha256$0a7f4b13c7b4d2c1e9c3d2a0dfc2b5a1d1a6c0c1a9c8c2f4b0a9e8d5c3b2a1f0), re-run a fresh PubMed keyword search for “CRISPR base editing off-target human cells” limited to 10 results so we have an up-to-date cached search today (2026-08-05), then pull metadata for the top-ranked returned PMID and attempt to download its PDF; finally, confirm the PDF download record status by fetching the download attempt by id.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns a search_request with tool_name = "search_pubmed_key_words", key_words = "CRISPR base editing off-target human cells", and result_count_returned = 10, plus an articles array with at least 1 element.
Step 1 returns an article whose pmid equals $0.articles.0.pmid and includes a source_url like https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/<pmid>/.
Step 2 returns a download record whose pmid equals $0.articles.0.pmid and has status in {"succeeded","failed"} (i.e., a completed attempt is recorded).
Step 3 returns the same download id as step 2 and reports a consistent status and, if succeeded, a non-null storage_path and http_status_code = 200.

tasks.task: For the Redwood Bioinformatics Lab account (API key hash sha256$0a7f4b13c7b4d2c1e9c3d2a0dfc2b5a1d1a6c0c1a9c8c2f4b0a9e8d5c3b2a1f0), re-run the keyword search "CRISPR base editing off-target human cells" and, before end of day, download the PDF for the top-ranked result and then confirm the download status by fetching the download record.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns a succeeded search_request and includes an articles array with at least one item containing a pmid.
Step 2 returns a download record with pmid equal to $0.articles.0.pmid and status either "succeeded" or a terminal failure with an error_message.
Step 3 returns the same download id as step 2 and confirms the current status and (if succeeded) a non-null storage_path.

tasks.task: For Redwood Bioinformatics Lab (API key sha256$0a7f4b13c7b4d2c1e9c3d2a0dfc2b5a1d1a6c0c1a9c8c2f4b0a9e8d5c3b2a1f0), before EOD today, rerun the keyword search "CRISPR base editing off-target human cells" and download the PDF for the top-ranked hit. Then verify the download record shows status=succeeded and provide the storage_path for our internal archive.

success_criteria: A new search_request is created for key_words="CRISPR base editing off-target human cells" with status="succeeded" and returns at least 1 article/PMID.
get_pubmed_article_metadata succeeds for the top article PMID returned by the search.
download_pubmed_pdf returns a download record id and status is not failed.
get_pdf_download for that id returns status="succeeded" and includes a non-null storage_path.
